newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech PX50 closes higher led by SPT Telecom.
newsitem.headline: Czech PX50 closes higher led by SPT Telecom.

text.p: The Czech PX50 index posted a small gain on Monday the first day of trading in 1996 with dealers seeing strong interest in blue chip issues.
The PX50 index rose 0.4 percent to 541.6 while the RPIX index fell 0.1 percent to 1,125.2 led by investment funds SPIF Cesky and Komercni IF.

SPT Telecom, the most heavily capitalised share on the bourse, gained 14 crowns to 3,400. Dealers said they were surprised that SPT had been so well supported at such levels but did not know how long it would last.

"There is still some demand for SPT even at these high levels which is unusual...it seems like the level is now supported by some people on the market but I don't know how strong the support is," said Lubomir Vystavel of ING Barings.

Support was also seen for power utility CEZ which rose nine crowns to 988. Vystavel said that CEZ was a good prospect for this year because of strong fundamentals and a relatively weak performance in the last quarter of 1996 when the share lost most of the gains it had made throught the year.
Overall, turnover was low at 745 million crowns.
